strings.<p>ש.גוטובסקי בע״מ בונה מאז 1972 את התשת:
Since 1972, S. Gotovski Ltd. has built the infrastructure beneath the fuel station forecourt, and from that same experience, the fuel infrastructure that feeds emergency generators at data centers. We are looking for a civil engineer or practical engineer for a meaningful, varied role with broad responsibility, combining engineering, procurement, planning and control. This is your chance to join a dynamic company, take part in complex engineering projects, shape processes end to end and grow with us into more senior roles.

What the role involves

  • Managing engineering interfaces with consultants, designers, supervisors and clients
  • Coordinating approvals of materials, equipment and engineering specifications
  • Managing engineering procurement, orders and delivery tracking
  • Reviewing drawings, quantity take-offs and construction control
  • Checking contractor and supplier invoices, and budget control
  • Building work processes, reports, and tracking and control systems

Must have

  • Registered civil engineer or practical engineer
  • At least 3 years of experience in a similar role on infrastructure, civil engineering or industrial projects
  • Excellent command of Excel

An advantage

  • Reading AutoCAD drawings and familiarity with Binaria software
  • Experience in fuel, gas or energy infrastructure (a significant advantage)
  • Independence, initiative, systems thinking, the ability to drive interfaces, and attention to detail

Why join us

  • Excellent, rewarding pay, according to experience and skills
  • Company car
  • Real influence and responsibility on significant projects
  • Professional and management advancement in a growing company
  • A dynamic, professional and entrepreneurial work environment

The position is open to women and men alike.

Since 1972, S. Gotovski Ltd. has built the infrastructure beneath the fuel station forecourt, and from that same experience, the fuel infrastructure that feeds emergency generators at data centers. The company runs several data center projects at the same time.

We are looking for a project manager to lead a construction project end to end: schedule, budget, safety and quality, working with an international client to a demanding standard and with the main contractor.

What the role includes

  • Managing the project end to end: schedule, budget, resources and subcontractor coordination
  • Running weekly status meetings with the client and the main contractor
  • Identifying change orders, managing them and getting them approved before work starts
  • Day-to-day coordination with the engineering, procurement and billing staff
  • Responsibility for meeting the client's safety and quality procedures on site
  • Managing the site's works manager and quality controller

Requirements

We are looking for a civil engineer or practical engineer for a meaningful, varied role with broad responsibility, combining engineering, procurement, planning and control.

  • Managing engineering interfaces with consultants, designers, supervisors and clients
  • Coordinating approvals of materials, equipment and engineering specifications
  • Managing engineering procurement, orders and delivery tracking
  • Reviewing drawings, quantity take-offs and construction control
  • Checking contractor and supplier invoices, and budget control

  • Company car
  • Real influence and responsibility on significant projects

  • A dynamic, professional and entrepreneurial work environment

Since 1972, S. Gotovski Ltd. has built the infrastructure beneath the fuel station forecourt, and from that same experience, the fuel infrastructure that feeds emergency generators at data centers. With several projects running at once, procurement in step with the site is what prevents delays and surplus stock.

We are looking for a procurement buyer to run procurement and logistics for all projects, order only approved items and time deliveries to the progress of the work.

What the role includes

  • Buying approved items only: no order goes out before the item is approved with the supervisor
  • Getting quotes, comparing them and negotiating with suppliers
  • Timing deliveries to the progress on site (just-in-time), including transport and lifting coordination
  • Tracking open orders and warning the project manager early about any expected delay
  • Preventing surplus stock and duplicate orders across projects

We are looking for a billing and collections coordinator to close the loop: submit every approved invoice on time, follow it daily until it is approved, and make sure it is entered and paid.

What the role includes

  • Submitting approved invoices to clients in the format and on the dates of each contract
  • Following each invoice daily until the supervisor approves it, and chasing it when it stalls
  • Confirming entry into the client's payment system and tracking the payment date
  • Checking supplier and subcontractor invoices against orders and delivery notes
